notes.title: v4.3 - Monotome, Axe & QoL
notes.content: [h1][b]New Perk (Blessing) - Monotome[/b][/h1][p]This brand new Blessing replaces your akimbo guns with a Monotome, an empowered tome that enhances your primary weapon with double damage. This allows you to use ADS while still increasing your weapons power, without sacrificing it with akimbo. This has both benefits and draw backs in that the ammo will last longer but the fire rate is lower.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44914133/6b404af5f55a7ddca90fc9bbbea3edbccd2d8b9f.png"][/img][/p][h1][b]New Weapon - Axe[/b][/h1][p]The third melee weapon to enter the trio of main melee weapons. The axe being the fastest but also the lowest range with an almost vertical swing, making this perfect for fast paced up close encounters. notes.title: v4.2 - Aim Down Sight & Health Bar
notes.content: [h1]Aim Down Sight[/h1][p]After countless requests, you can now finally aim down the sights of your gun. Doing so will stop you from sprinting; however, it will increase your accuracy and reduce your recoil, allowing you to make more precise shots—especially useful in the early waves. Once you upgrade to akimbo, you will no longer be able to aim down the sights.[/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44914133/4233977aa4acdcc3257f2282a5aad76bed0c2d3d.png"][/img][/h3][h1]Health Bar[/h1][p]Also after countless requests, there is now a Health Bar, which appears below the Kinetic Energy Bar. The bar’s colour changes dynamically based on your current state:[/p][list][*][p][b]Low Health:[/b] If you are low on health and the next hit would kill you, the bar turns dark.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Immunity Frames:[/b] If you get hit and are temporarily invulnerable, the bar flashes brighter.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Vitality Surge:[/b] If your health is boosted above the maximum, the bar becomes pink.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Necrovore Active:[/b] If Necrovore is active, the bar becomes a brighter and whiter.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Retribution Active:[/b] If Retribution is active, the bar turns yellow. (The golden outline around the wave number has been removed; this is now how you’ll know Retribution is active.)[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44914133/cd02f20e2997eb2db2ad9e5e48a4c50c9721efd6.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]v4.2.2 Changes[/h2][list][*][p]Added two new modifiers "Disable Kinetic Energy" and "Infinite Kinetic"[/p][/*][*][p]The achievement "True Classic Zombies" now requires "Disable Kinetic Energy" to be active.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed the "Air Dash" keybind, it is now the same as Jump.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p]

notes.title: v4.1 - IRRADIATED
notes.content: [h1]IRRADIATED[/h1][h3]Introducing a brand new special wave type: [b]Irradiated[/b][/h3][p]These zombies are dripping with radiation and far more dangerous than they look. Keep your distance—when they die, they release a toxic burst that will irradiate anyone nearby. Get too close, and you’ll pay the price.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44914133/f121efdc3543c87d7ef5237c78743c6269e2a19d.png"][/img][/p][h1][b]Irradiated[/b] Achievements[/h1][h2][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44914133/4708ada0443018745f593f4c619085ebdd850858.png"][/img][/h2][h1]In other news...[/h1][list][*][p]Purchasing ammo now completely refills your ammo, the price scales with how much ammo you are purchasing.[/p][/*][*][p]The camera shake when taking damage now scales with how much damage you take.[/p][/*][*][p]The achievement "Triple Threat" has been changed to "Quadruple Threat" and requires Permanent Irradiate to be enabled too. The icon has also changed.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: v4.0 - DEADZONE
notes.content: [h1]DEADZONE[/h1][h3]Introducing the newest game mode: [b]Deadzone[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44914133/46f1ae0379cd1857ee92053c9d35845146ce6f4b.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Deadzone[/b] is a whole new way to play Nasty Zombies, locking you into a specific area of the map that shifts with each wave.[/p][p]Follow the [b]Skull[/b] — it marks the [b]Deadzone[/b]. Stay within its radius to stay safe, but stray too far and you’ll start taking damage. Unblocking more zones will make the [b]Deadzone[/b] more forgiving.[/p][p]This is a [b]more challenging[/b] way to play Nasty Zombies, and you will be heavily rewarded. For every wave you complete, the [b]Skull[/b] will give you coins; the higher the wave, the more coins you will receive.[/p][p]You can also claim the [b]Deadzone Skull[/b] as your own, and wear it as a head; reach wave 100 in the [b]Deadzone[/b] game mode to acquire it![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44914133/df926681887b52a2f3341fda414d9ab2502dc642.png"][/img][/p][p]On top of this, there is a whole new set of leaderboards for you to conquer.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44914133/db96c5233bb671cee587d08a2e28e44cf0faced3.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h1]Deadzone Achievements[/h1][h2]Deadzone Hermit[/h2][p]Reach wave 25 without unblocking any zones, with the "Locked Inside" modifier active, in the Deadzone Game Mode.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44914133/671f369df28043522136d985662130aa53d744ad.png"][/img][/p][h2]Deadzoned[/h2][p]Reach wave 50 in the Deadzone Game Mode without being damaged by the Deadzone.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44914133/ff3e3797a0321da92e28018a1c176cf93e59a29e.png"][/img][/p][h2]Ultimate Deadzoner[/h2][p]Reach wave 100 in the Deadzone Game Mode.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44914133/39c57b3447deaa99bb4a3e019f74e04949a65229.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h1]In other news...[/h1][h3]Mystery Box Changes[/h3][list][*][p]Getting a Wumbo Weapon will become more common with each gamble.[/p][/*][*][p]You can no longer roll the same weapon twice in a row.[/p][/*][*][p]The Mystery Box is less likely to move.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Other Changes[/h3][list][*][p]Gunslinger now reduces weapon recoil, instead of entirely removing it.[/p][/*][*][p]Retribution is less bright.[/p][/*][*][p]Zombie bleeding particles now stop 5 seconds after a limb is removed (this is when they stop taking bleed damage).[/p][/*][*][p]Decayed Zombies no longer take bleed damage when they lose their arms, only their legs.[/p][/*][*][p]Decayed Zombies are now guaranteed to spawn with at least 1 missing body part.[/p][/*][*][p]The Discord status now displays what Map and Game Mode you are playing.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44914133/0abd97fff9716e7c15887ea8db5bd7cbdd10624f.png"][/img][/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: v3.0 - Enter the Backrooms
notes.content:
[h1]Enter the Backrooms[/h1]
This month marks the one-year anniversary of Nasty Zombies, and we're celebrating in the best way possible — with a brand new map: The Backrooms.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44914133/44364abd8144847e175797a31736c3a9bbe7fbda.png[/img]
Now, I know what you're thinking — this isn't The Farm. That’s still on the way and very much in progress. But in the meantime, The Backrooms should give you something fresh (and freaky) to sink your teeth into.

This isn’t just a reskin of The Church. The Backrooms plays completely differently.
There are no waves. No breaks. Just floors — and your goal? Descend as deep as you can into the endless, ever-changing maze.

Each floor brings new layouts, new tension, and new challenges. The deeper you go, the more unstable the environment becomes. Will you adapt... or will you become just another lost soul wandering the yellow halls?

[h1]In other news...[/h1]
[list]
[*]You can now double tap and hold the weapon switch button to continuously cycle through your weapons.
[/list]

notes.title: v2.34 - The Decayed Update
notes.content:
[h1]The Decayed Update[/h1]
This update shakes up gameplay with Decay, a brutal new zombie wave that forces you to rethink your strategy. We've also added a brand-new movement ability, Air Dash, giving you more mobility in combat. The Marathon perk is gone—stamina is no longer a concern, so you can sprint endlessly. A fresh perk, Kinetic Recovery, takes marathons place, it rewards movement with faster healing.

[h2]New Wave: Decayed[/h2]
The nasty just got even nastier. In "Decayed" waves, zombies will spawn decayed, with missing arms, and sometimes, even without a head, yet they’ll keep coming for you like nothing happened. They don’t need eyes to hunt you down, so stay sharp, switch up your strategies because these relentless husks won’t go down easily.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44914133/08b88a6461e4f5e33c072f020ee8b9f2a52b4b01.jpg[/img]

- Marathon has been removed from the game, you no longer have stamina and can sprint forever.

notes.title: v2.24 - Chronomotion & Fortify Rework
notes.content:
[h1]Chronopulse & Fortify Rework[/h1]

[h2]Chronopulse (formerly Chronomotion)[/h2]
Chronomotion was an exciting concept, but in practice, it slowed the game down too much, often leading players to disable it. I've now reimagined it as Chronopulse.

In this updated version, time slows down only when Nasty Zombies are dangerously close, giving you the chance to escape intense situations without interrupting the flow of gameplay.

[h2]Fortify[/h2]
Fortify’s original function of repairing all barricades was helpful but unintentionally slowed the game, forcing players to wait as zombies broke through again.

Now, Fortify not only repairs barricades but also enhances them with an electrifying edge. When zombies attack fortified barricades, they’ll take damage and eventually die.

have fun :)

notes.title: v2.14 - Z-Ray Vision

notes.title: v2.13 - No Rest for the Wicked
notes.content:
[h2]Next Wave Setting[/h2]
You are now able to choose how the next wave will start:
[list][*][b]Auto[/b], which is what it was previously by default where it will automatically start after some time, which can be bypassed by pressing the next wave button.

To go along with the next wave setting, there is a new achievement for reaching wave 75 with the setting set to instant.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44914133/a027a6439843fd0c788c1c5ae0abf1396cc49970.png[/img]

[list]
[*]You can now close the pause menu by pressing Escape.

notes.title: v2.12 - Popup Overhaul
notes.content:
[h2]Popup Overhaul[/h2]
[list]
[*] The popup when you master a weapon now flies into the screen and the text is formatted differently.
[*] There is now a popup when you unlock a new head.
[/list]

notes.title: v2.11 - Shooting Rework
notes.content:
[h2]Shooting Rework[/h2]
[list]
[*]When you fire a weapon, you can hold fire to queue up the next shot, allowing for tick perfect shots.

[h2]In other news...[/h2]
[list]
[*]Your prestige level is now displayed in the lobby.
[*]The Sten has had its weapon spread increased to differentiate it more from the Bren.
[*]The M134 has had its weapon spread increased slightly.
[*]Zombies spawn closer to the barricades. This will speed up the earlier waves.
[*]There are slightly more variations to the crate room to prevent it being too powerful.

[/list]

notes.title: v2.10 - Enraged Buff
notes.content:
[h2]Enraged Buff[/h2]
Enraged Nasty Zombies will be at their maximum potential speed.

[h2]Power-Ups[/h2]
Power-Ups now have a .25 delay before being able to be activated.

[h2]Stats Computer[/h2]
[list]
[*]The Combined scores have been removed until there is more than 1 map.
[*]The Prestige button is now located at the bottom centre.
[/list]

notes.title: v2.9 - Jump Animations
notes.content:
[h2]Jump Animations[/h2]
The player now has a jump animation where their robe thins as they jump, and bellows as they land.

[h2]In other news...[/h2][list]
[*]Zombies will now attack their new target if they changed targets while their new target was already in attack range.
[*]Zombies will always face the thing that they are targeting, be it a barricade or a player.

notes.title: v2.8 - Zombie Pathing Changes
notes.content:
[h2]Zombie Pathing Changes[/h2]
Zombies can now path back through the courtyard. There have also been some changes to their spawn locations.

[h2]Multiplayer Rebalance[/h2]
There are now less zombies per player in multiplayer, this will make getting to higher waves faster. There is now slight random variance in the amount of zombies per wave.

[h2]Wave 100 Speed Leaderboards[/h2]
There are now speedrunner leaderboards for every party size!

notes.title: v2.7 - Speedrun Leaderboard
notes.content:
[h2]Speedrun Leaderboard[/h2]
Introducing a new leaderboard where the top players can compete to see who can reach wave 100 in the fastest time.

[h2]In other news...[/h2]
The stats computer has had some changes so you can now go back to the previous page instead of entirely exiting the computer.

notes.title: v2.6 - New Achievement - 100 Under 100
notes.content:
[h2]100 Under 100[/h2]
Here's a brand new achievement to challenge even the most veteran players. If you thought 50 Under 50 was though, just wait until you see its big brother... 100 Under 100: Reach wave 100 in less than 100 minutes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44914133/922d18f2c605bd2daf9a738b41bad1a0ca31174b.png[/img]

notes.title: v2.5.2 - Lighting Quality Settings
notes.content:
[h2]Lighting Quality Settings[/h2]
You can now switch between High, Medium, and Low lighting quality settings. Previously High was the only option. Medium and low look significantly worse, especially during the day, but run significantly better.

notes.title: v2.5 - Bug Fixes
notes.content:
[h2]Penetration Bug Fix[/h2]
When bullets penetrate multiple zombies, your damage will no longer go negative and heal the zombies.

[h2]Mutliplayer Game Crashing Fixed[/h2]
The host's game will no longer crash when returning the party to the lobby. This was caused by VOIP and has been removed.

notes.title: v2.4b
notes.content:
[h2]Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*]"Sharpshooter" achievement is now easier to obtain. It now only checks the first zombie you hit, though you must only hit the head, hitting another body part while the zombie is alive will prevent you from getting the achievement. Any collateral hits don't affect obtaining the achievement.
[*]The text under Perks and Power-Ups is now slightly larger.
[*]The text under Perks now says how many perks you can have equipped in words instead of in numerals.
[*]The pixelisation setting is now known as pixelation.

notes.title: v2.4 - Pixelation
notes.content:
[h1]Pixelation[/h1]

[h2]Pixelation[/h2]There are now pixelation settings. You can set how pixelated you want the game to be. 

You can choose from [b]High / Medium / Low / No[/b] Pixelation.

Be aware, the lower you go the more of an impact it will make on performance.

[h2]In other news...[/h2]
[list]
[*] Significant changes have been made to the crate room, you should now find that they have far more viable layouts.
[*] Adjusted the zombies player targeting system, they should now have more variety in who they target, especially at long distances from their spawn point.
[*] The "Take a weapon and defend yourself" popup has been removed.
[*] Fixed a bug with the ceiling having weird lighting artifacts.
[*] Zombies will no longer collide with dead zombies outside of the barricade.
[*] You will no longer uncrouch if you were uncrouching at the same time as dying.
[/list]

notes.title: v2.3 - Zoomies and Bloomies
notes.content:
[h1]Zoomies and Bloomies[/h1]

[b][h2]Zoomies[/h2][/b]Zoomies now allows you to move at full speed whilst crouched.

[b][h2]Bloomies[/h2][/b]The sun now starts higher in the sky and has beautiful bloom effects and light shafts.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44914133/7ec583e78d2a99ea1c73578de8935172becc8cbc.jpg[/img]
[b][h2]In Other News...[/h2][/b][list]
[*]Retribution now has a 15 minute cooldown, upped from 10 minutes.
[*]All crates except for those in the crate room have been removed.
[*]Removed the high wall in the Lee Enfield room and replaced it with a horisontal pillar that you can crouch under. This has random locations.
[*]New potential layouts in the left side room in the basement to replace the crates.

notes.title: v2.2 - Vegetation
notes.content:
[h1]Vegetation[/h1]
A small update today, but it makes a big impact to the aesthetics of The Compound!

[b][h2]Trees and Bushes[/h2][/b]There are now random trees and bushes outside of The Compound!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44914133/8600eb7f1a4f5b2c326def18389ac21dcb0bc59e.png[/img]

notes.title: v2.1.2 - Movement and Animations
notes.content:
[h1]Movement and Animations[/h1]

[b][h2]Animations[/h2][/b]Animations are now smoother for both yourself and other players. You will notice that your crouch height is slightly higher too.

[b][h2]Move Whilst Dead[/h2][/b]You can now move when you are dead, so long as at least 1 other player is alive, allowing you to better spectate. 

[b][h2]Prestige[/h2][/b]Prestige is now displayed as Roman Numerals.

[h2]In other news...[/h2][list][*]Leaving the game whilst you are targeted by Enraged Zombies will no longer soft lock the game.
[*]Players can no longer join a game that is already in progress.
[*]You can no longer die in a crouched location and then revive into a wall.
[*]Footstep sounds are more audible.
[*]Your camera and crosshair no longer move when you move, only your weapon will, allowing for more accurate aiming whilst moving.
[*]The Winchester won't make extremely loud sounds when you shoot lots of things at once.
[*]Zombies can no longer get stuck on each other.

notes.title: v2.1.1 - Achievement Fixes and Menu Features
notes.content:
[h1]Achievement Fixes and Menu Features[/h1]

[b][h2]New Menu Features[/h2][/b][list]
[*] In the main menu (so long as you haven't used the text chat) you can now press F to toggle your amulet light, and E to activate a random power-up!
[*] The menu moves super smoothly and is a little more zoomed out.
[/list]
[b][h2]Achievement Fixes[/h2][/b][list]
[*]"Globetrotter" is now achievable.

[/list]Thank you Mr.alek for reporting these on the community [url=https://discord.com/invite/jEs7r52Xs7]Discord[/url]!

notes.title: v2.1 - Voice & Text Chat
notes.content:
[h1]Voice & Text Chat[/h1]I've got a bunch of nice features for multiplayer including voice and text chat!

[b][h2]Voice Chat[/h2][/b]You can now talk with your voice, with either Push to Talk or voice activate. By default it is push to talk.

[b][h2]Text Chat[/h2][/b]You can send messages in the lobby and in game. Press Enter to type in game, or click the text box to type in the lobby.

[b][h2]Smoother Character Animations[/h2][/b]The character animations have been overhauled to be a lot smoother and move at different speeds.

[b][h2]Fortify & Carpenter Buff[/h2][/b]Fortify now rebuilds 10 planks if you have Carpenter enabled.

notes.title: v2.0.2 - Discord & Multiplayer Changes
notes.content:
[h1]Discord & Multiplayer Changes[/h1]
I hope you’re all enjoying playing Nasty Zombies together! If you’re looking to jump into multiplayer but don’t have anyone to team up with, I’ve got great news—I’ve launched a Discord server where you can connect with others, make new friends, and form a party to take on the undead together.

[b][h2]Join Our Discord![/h2][/b]Our new Discord server is the perfect place to:
[list]
[*] Discuss all things Nasty Zombies
[*] Share your best screenshots and gameplay clips
[*] Stay up to date with the latest news and updates
[*] Find other people to team up and slay Nasty Zombies with![/list]You can also access the Discord directly through the new Socials tab added to the game’s main menu.
[url=https://discord.com/invite/jEs7r52Xs7]Click here to join the Discord![/url]

[b][h2]Rebalance[/h2][/b][list]
[*]Nasty Zombie's coin drops are now worth 10% more per player in the game.
Solo = 100% Value │ Duo = 110% Value │ Trio = 120% Value │ Quad = 130% Value
[*]Lee Enfield now deals 225 base damage, upped from 200.
[/list]
[b][h2]In Other News...[/h2][/b][list]
[*]Crawlers no longer have collision so you can't be body blocked by them.
[*]Chronomotion no longer takes effect between waves.

[*]Player walk animations are now more obvious and the footstep sound is synched with the animation.
[*]You can now interact with the Pause Menu if the "Start Next Wave" interface pops up.
[*]Changed some details on the discord status to include party size and prestige level.
[/list]

notes.title: v2.0 - MULTIPLAYER
notes.content:
[h1]MULTIPLAYER[/h1]Multiplayer is finally here. Thank you all for your patience over the summer with the lack of updates, it was a mammoth task to not only learn how to make a multiplayer game, but then to completely rewrite the entire game to work in multiplayer. I'm really proud of what I've managed to accomplish and I hope you all have fun playing with your friends!

If you do happen to find any bugs please message me either on X, or make a post in the community discussions. Also take lots of screenshots and post them, I'll be updating the store page with any cool pictures that I see.

[b][h2]The Hollow Monks[/h2][/b]Out of the shadows, the Hollow Monks appeared—silent, ethereal figures, cloaked in flowing robes with no bodies within. No one knows where they came from, but their purpose is clear: to cleanse the world of the zombie scourge. Armed with divine energy and unyielding resolve, they wage a relentless war against the undead, purging every cursed soul in their path. They are the last hope for a world on the brink of oblivion.

[b][h2]Create a Party[/h2][/b]Create a party and invite your friends to play, you can play in groups of up to 4.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44914133/a0e8fef987d10fc5136369f00f6d7078da60ecfd.png[/img]
[b][h2]Customisation[/h2][/b]Customise your robes to stand out from your friends! You can also change your head, but you'll have to discover it first (it's a secret).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44914133/31f4539874eb18f832334f3ee8329a291704fc47.png[/img]
[b][h2]Party Leaderboards[/h2][/b]Compete for your spot at the top of the new leaderboards. There are leaderboards for each party size.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44914133/bfef1f0501c72bceef01d47fba529de56e5c8d23.png[/img]
[b][h2]Wave Scaling[/h2][/b]As your party size increases, the number of zombies per wave increases, as well as their max health.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44914133/c2bc3ede5e782aa9c42dfbb1ac6e7acb21b4494d.jpg[/img]
[h2]In other news...[/h2][list][*]The Sten and Bren are now randomly assigned their locations, it is also different for each player.
[*]The M134 and Winchester are now randomly assigned their locations, it is also different for each player.
[*]The player's light is far less bright at close range, so you can actually see your weapon instead of it being washed out by light.
[*]Bug fixes.[/list]
[h3]The Future[/h3]
Now that multiplayer is here, I'm going to turn my attention back to working on the next map! Keep your eyes peeled for more info.

notes.title: v1.1.7 - Part 4 of Preparing for Multiplayer
notes.content:
[h1]Part 4 of Preparing for Multiplayer[/h1]
This will probably be the last update before the release of multiplayer. I'm aiming for multiplayer to be released in early October, so long as everything goes smoothly.

notes.title: v1.1.6 - Part 3 of Preparing for Multiplayer

notes.title: v1.1.5 - Part 2 of Preparing for Multiplayer
notes.content:
[h1]Part 2 of Preparing for Multiplayer[/h1]
I have some more changes in preparation for multiplayer that I thought I would release now since they're ready to go! Also big thanks to everyone who has been reporting bugs to me. If you do find any bugs or issues, just message me on X or make a post on the community hub.

[b][h3]New Wave Type[/h3][/b]There is a brand new type of wave that can randomly occur after you reach wave 25. I won't spoil what it is, though, it will certainly spice up those later rounds for those of you who are good enough to get to wave 50+.

[b][h3]New Prestige Leaderboard[/h3][/b]You can now compete for rank 1 on the prestige leaderboard.

[b][h3]In-Game Clock Change[/h3][/b]The in game clock is now always displayed to the top left of the screen.

[b][h3]Coffin Room Changes[/h3][/b]There are now significantly more variations to the Coffin Room containing the M134.

[h2]In other news...[/h2][list][*]Zombie health will continue to scale up after wave 25, though it will scale up significantly slower than pre-25.
[*]Crawlers deal half damage instead of full damage.

notes.title: v1.1.4 - Preparing for Multiplayer
notes.content:
[h1]Preparing for Multiplayer[/h1]
I'm pushing this patch out early ahead of multiplayer's launch so I have the foundations ready, it has a bunch of new features too. I'm expecting multiplayer to launch by the end of September, so long as everything goes smoothly.

[b][h3]New Post Game Summary[/h3][/b]At the end of a game, there is now a post game summary, this replaces the "Score Room".
(I know score room was fun but I had to remove it (the music was copyright)).

[b][h3]New Leaderboards[/h3][/b]There are now leaderboards for each party size from 1 to 4. (Multiplayer coming very soon!)

[b][h3]New VFX[/h3][/b]Nuke and Retribution have had visual makeovers to be far more epic!

[b][h3]New Hit Effect[/h3][/b]When taking damage, your screen will move to make it more obvious when you're taking damage.

[b][h3]New Light[/h3][/b]The Flashlight has been replaced by a light. This will make more sense once multiplayer launches.

[h2]In other news...[/h2][list][*]The Winchester now has less penetration and only 1.5x headshot damage, but now has significantly more base damage, deals 1x limb damage and has increased accuracy.
[*]The Lee Enfield now deals 3x headshot damage.
[*]The Zombie Spawning system has been reworked, they should be more likely to spawn nearer you.
[*]Hardened flesh has been nerfed, you will now only be able to tank 1 extra hit instead of 2.
[*]Rapid reload is now only 2x faster instead of 2.5x.
[*]The in game time should now be accurate.
[*]Zombies will make death sounds again (oops).

I think that's everything. I hope you're all looking forward to multiplayer.

notes.title: v1.1.2 - Barricade Rebalance
notes.content:

[list]
[*]When a Nasty Zombie has hit a barricade 10 times, it will deal an additional plank of damage. Every 5 hits after this, it will deal another additional plank of damage. (This is to prevent a build-up of Nasty Zombies outside of the barricades as there will be less and less zombies inside the map as more build up outside).
[*]When a barricade is completely destroyed, there is a 1 second cooldown before you can repair it again.
[/list]

[list]
[*]You will no longer get stuck when trying to jump when surrounded by Nasty Zombies.
[/list]

notes.title: v1.1 - The Nasty Perks Update
notes.content:
[h1]NEW PERKS[/h1][b][h3]Rapid Reload[/h3][/b]Reload you weapons incredibly fast. There'll be no more waiting around when you have to refill you guns.

[b][h3]Carpenter[/h3][/b]Repair barricades twice as fast, and place twice as many planks on entry points. You will be able to control sections of the map with ease.

[b][h3]Zoomies[/h3][/b]Get the Zoomies and move faster than any nasty zombie ever could. They'll never catch you at these speeds.

[b][h3]Ruction[/h3][/b]Melee weapons will always kill Nasty Zombies in one singular hit. This will help you fly through the early waves without spending a penny.

[h2]In other news...[/h2][list][*]Prices of Perks have been rebalanced, they start off more expensive but don't increase by as much with each purchase.
[*]4 brand new achievements to go along with the new perks.
[*]Added a burning barrel light source to the bottom of the stairs room as it was a bit too dark.
[*]Modified the main menu to have more Nasty Zombies.

[/list][h2]Upcoming[/h2]
Sorry about the lack of updates the past few months, I have been working on implementing multiplayer which has required a lot of self teaching as I've never worked with multiplayer before. I have made good progress so I'm really hoping I can get it out as soon as possible.
